ti.title: ወላዲተ ኣምላኽ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ብቓሉ ዓለማት ከይፈጠረ ገና
ህልውቲ ነበርኪ ብእግዚአብሔር ሕሊና
ካብ ኣብራኽ ኢያቄም ካብ ማህጸን ሃና
ኣዲኡ ክትኮኒ ሓርዩኪ ኣምላኽና
[[/chorus]]

ወላዲተ ኣምላኽ ማርያም ድንግል (2)
ፍሉይ’ዩ ክብርኺ (2) ካብ ኩሎም ፍጥረት

ካብ መላእክቲ ኩሎም ትበልጺ ንስኺ
ካብ ደቂ ሰባት’ውን የለን ዝመስለኪ
ኣብ ቅድሚ እግዚአብሔር ስምኪ ዝገነነ
ኣይተረኽበን ድንግል ከማኺ ዝበለ

ti_ro.title: Weladite amlakh
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Weladite amlakh maryam dngl (2)
[[/chorus]]

Fluy’yu kbrkhi (2) kab kulom ftret
Bqalu alemat keyfetere gena
Hlwti neberki bgziabher hlina
Kab abrakh iyaqem kab mahtsen hana
Adiu ktkoni haryuki amlakhna
Kab melakti kulom tbeltsi nskhi
Kab deqi sebat’wn yelen zmesleki
Ab qdmi gziabher smki zgenene
Ayterekhben dngl kemakhi zbele
Newri zeyblki’khi ntshti merat
Qdsti ngsti natna memekhit
Aden dngln weladite qal
Zeytlweti’ikhi zelalem dngl
